nicknames: Home of the Los Alamitos Two Million

main_dirt.circumference: 5/8 mile oval (1,000 metres / 5 furlongs) with dedicated 440-yard straightaway chute
main_dirt.surface: Dirt (Engineered silt and sand loam cushion for maximum sprint traction)
main_dirt.bias_notes: Counter-clockwise (left-handed) for oval races; straightaway chute for 220y-440y dashes. Premier Quarter Horse venue in North America operating night meetings year-round. Straightaway dashes (220y, 300y, 330y, 350y, 400y, 440y) are pure speed tests where first-step gate break ('E' style) is 90% decisive. Off-pace closing ('C') is virtually non-existent in short dashes unless an early leader breaks down or stumbles out of the gate.
main_dirt.post_bias: MIDDLE-TO-OUTSIDE DRAW ADVANTAGE IN STRAIGHTAWAY DASHES: In 220y to 400y sprints, post draws 4 through 8 provide cleaner straightaway paths away from inside gate crowding. Outside draws (6-10) in 400y and 440y G1 Futurities allow horses to extend their stride without inside interference.

handicapping_angles.premier_g1_futurity_and_champion_of_cham: Los Alamitos hosts America's most prestigious Quarter Horse events: Los Alamitos Two Million Futurity ($2M G1), Golden State Million Futurity ($1M G1), Ed Burke Million Futurity ($1M G1), and the Champion of Champions ($750k G1). Trial heat time qualifiers and top-tier Speed Index (SI 95-105+) earners hold absolute authority (+4.0 pts class angle).
handicapping_angles.gate_break_first_step_acceleration_lock: In Quarter Horse racing, the break out of the starting gate determines 90% of outcomes. Horses with proven top 60-yard split times and elite gate jockeys (e.g. Jesus Rios Ayala, Armando Viramontes) receive a major break-speed upgrade (+4.0 pts).
handicapping_angles.aqha_speed_index_si_rating: Utilize AQHA Speed Index (SI) as the foundational speed metric. Horses earning consistent SI 95+ ratings against graded stakes competition carry a decisive advantage over SI 85-89 regional horses.
handicapping_angles.elite_trainer_trial_heat_dominance: Hall of Fame and top-tier Quarter Horse trainers (e.g. Paul Jones, Monty Arrossa, Jaime Gomez, Heath Taylor, Jose Flores) dominate futurity trial nights and stakes finals. Grant trainer trial execution bonus (+2.5 pts).
handicapping_angles.night_racing_track_firmness: Night racing in Orange County produces cooler temperatures that firm up the dirt cushion, causing the surface to play extremely fast. Early speed ('E') holds a dominant bias on cool evening tracks.
handicapping_angles.870_yard_distance_turn_specialists: In 870-yard races (around one turn), Thoroughbred/Quarter Horse crossover horses with strong 4.5f-5f round-turn experience gain a distinct advantage over pure straightaway sprinters.
